studies_overlap: Holds pairwise variant overlap counts between two studies; grain = one row per variant pair (A_study_id, A_chrom, A_pos, A_ref, A_alt, B_study_id, B_chrom, B_pos, B_ref, B_alt); notable measures/keys = A_study_id, B_study_id, A_chrom, A_pos, A_ref, A_alt, B_chrom, B_pos, B_ref, B_alt, A_distinct, AB_overlap, B_distinct
locus2gene: Maps study-specific loci to genes with model training metadata and model probability outputs; grain = one row per study locus → gene (study_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, gene_id); notable measures/keys = study_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, gene_id, training_clf, training_gs, training_fold, y_proba_dist_foot, y_proba_dist_tss, y_proba_full_model, y_proba_logi_distance, y_proba_logi_interaction, y_proba_logi_molecularQTL, y_proba_logi_pathogenicity, y_proba_logo_distance, y_proba_logo_interaction, y_proba_logo_molecularQTL, y_proba_logo_pathogenicity
variant_gene: Per-variant–gene annotations and scores from multiple predictors and QTLs; grain = one row per variant–gene pair (chr_id, position, ref_allele, alt_allele, gene_id); notable measures/keys = chr_id, position, ref_allele, alt_allele, gene_id, feature, type_id, source_id, fpred_labels, fpred_scores, fpred_max_label, fpred_max_score, qtl_beta, qtl_se, qtl_pval, qtl_score, interval_score, qtl_score_q, interval_score_q, d, distance_score, distance_score_q
ot_release: Contains a single release identifier for the resource; grain = one row per release; notable measures/keys = release
variants: Catalog of variants with identifiers, consequences and allele frequencies including liftover to b37 and linked gene IDs; grain = one row per variant (chr_id, position, ref_allele, alt_allele); notable measures/keys = chr_id, position, ref_allele, alt_allele, chr_id_b37, position_b37, rs_id, most_severe_consequence, cadd, af, gene_id_any_distance, gene_id_any, gene_id_prot_coding_distance, gene_id_prot_coding
variant_disease_coloc: Results of colocalization tests between a variant and disease/trait signals; grain = one row per tested colocalization (left variant vs right trait/study) (left_study/variant and right_study/trait fields identify the pair); notable measures/keys = coloc_n_vars, coloc_h0, coloc_h1, coloc_h2, coloc_h3, coloc_h4, left_type, left_study, left_chrom, left_pos, left_ref, left_alt, right_type, right_study, right_bio_feature, right_phenotype, right_chrom, right_pos, right_ref, right_alt, coloc_h4_h3, coloc_log2_h4_h3, is_flipped, right_gene_id, left_var_right_study_beta, left_var_right_study_se, left_var_right_study_pval, left_var_right_isCC
variant_disease_credset: Credible set and fine-mapping posterior probabilities linking variants to genes/phenotypes; grain = one row per variant-in-credset/per-tag record (study_id/phenotype_id with variant identifiers); notable measures/keys = bio_feature, gene_id, is95_credset, is99_credset, lead_alt, lead_chrom, lead_pos, lead_ref, lead_variant_id, logABF, multisignal_method, phenotype_id, postprob, postprob_cumsum, study_id, tag_alt, tag_beta, tag_beta_cond, tag_chrom, tag_pos, tag_pval, tag_pval_cond, tag_ref, tag_se, tag_se_cond, tag_variant_id, type
sa_molecular_trait: Summary association statistics for molecular traits (e.g., QTLs) per variant–gene/phenotype; grain = one row per molecular trait association (type_id, study_id, phenotype_id, gene_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt); notable measures/keys = type_id, study_id, phenotype_id, gene_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, beta, se, pval, n_total, n_cases, eaf, mac, mac_cases, num_tests, info, is_cc, bio_feature
variant_disease: Study-level lead variant and association summary for disease/trait loci; grain = one row per reported association/study–locus (study_id, lead_chrom, lead_pos, lead_ref, lead_alt); notable measures/keys = study_id, lead_chrom, lead_pos, lead_ref, lead_alt, direction, beta, beta_ci_lower, beta_ci_upper, odds_ratio, oddsr_ci_lower, oddsr_ci_upper, pval_mantissa, pval_exponent, pval, ancestry_initial, ancestry_replication, n_cases, n_initial, n_replication, pmid, pub_author, pub_date, pub_journal, pub_title, has_sumstats, num_assoc_loci, source, trait_reported, trait_efos, trait_category, tag_chrom, tag_pos, tag_ref, tag_alt, overall_r2, pics_95perc_credset, AFR_1000G_prop, AMR_1000G_prop, EAS_1000G_prop
disease_variant_gene: Integrated disease–variant–gene records combining publication/study metadata with fine-mapping/posterior metrics; grain = one row per reported disease variant → gene (study_id, lead variant, gene info implied); notable measures/keys = study_id, source, pmid, pub_date, pub_journal, pub_title, pub_author, has_sumstats, trait_reported, trait_efos, ancestry_initial, ancestry_replication, n_initial, n_replication, n_cases, trait_category, num_assoc_loci, lead_chrom, lead_pos, lead_ref, lead_alt, tag_chrom, tag_pos, tag_ref, tag_alt, overall_r2, AFR_1000G_prop, AMR_1000G_prop, EAS_1000G_prop, EUR_1000G_prop, SAS_1000G_prop, log10_ABF, posterior_prob, odds_ratio, oddsr_ci_lower, oddsr_ci_upper, direction, beta, beta_ci_lower, beta_ci_upper
sa_gwas: Summary association statistics for GWAS per variant in a study; grain = one row per GWAS variant (type_id, study_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt); notable measures/keys = type_id, study_id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, beta, se, pval, n_total, n_cases, eaf, mac, mac_cases, info, is_cc
genes: Gene reference table with coordinates, strand, biotype and basic annotation; grain = one row per gene (gene_id); notable measures/keys = biotype, chr, description, end, exons, fwdstrand, gene_id, gene_name, start, tss
studies: Entity: genetic association study; Grain: one row per study (one study_id); Keys/measures: study_id (identifier), ancestry_initial, ancestry_replication, n_cases, n_initial, n_replication, pmid, pub_author, pub_date, pub_journal, pub_title, has_sumstats, num_assoc_loci, source, trait_reported, trait_efos, trait_category
